description: Ω10 — the self-knowledge ENGINE plugin (D-215): a DERIVED, never-authoritative model of the system. mind.snapshot@1 assembles the WorldModel (kernel/plugins, routable ops with risk+provider, projected message entities, DERIVED contact entities learned from message history, director rules, taught lexicon, context refs) from three evidence sources: law.registry@1 (who is alive), vault.query@1 + vault.getmany@1 (what exists: ns email / automation / nlcl — D-387 batched window reads), and composition-config projections (how to see). Both ENGINE contributions declare no risk BY KIND — risk is CONTRACT-kind data (sdk validator law); the ops are READ semantics: the mind holds no write capability and writes nothing, so a wrong self-model is falsifiable against intact evidence. Determinism: same vault state + same registry + same config ⇒ same WorldModel; v is a function of evidence counts, t is the only clock (supplied outside the pure shapes). Contact derivation uses contactFromAddress from @vivim/omega-nlcl-pure so browser/server/compartment derivations are byte-identical (N1). CONFIG (composition entry passthrough — data, never authority; validated fail-closed at init): { "composition": "console", "nlclVersion": "0.1.0", "selfAddresses": ["me@omega.local", "demo@omega.local"], "entityCap": 200, "ops": [{"op":"message.send@1","risk":"EXTERNAL_MUTATION","provider":"provider.email.file","title":"send a message"}, …] } — the ops catalog is RECIPE DATA (the user-signed grant is the authority for what the system can do); the registry cross-check adds liveness: ops whose provider is not active in the registry snapshot are filtered out. mind.query@1 {kind: "ops"|"entities"|"rules"|"lexicon"|"plugins"|"contacts", filter?} returns the requested slice (filter = case-insensitive substring on the row's identifying fields).

engine.doc: snapshot {} or {includeBodies?: boolean} → {world: WorldModel} — the full grounding target (nlcl-pure WorldModel shape exactly). includeBodies defaults true (forward/compose grounding needs bodies); false strips data.body from message entities for light replication. READ semantics by kind — engines declare no risk; the mind performs no writes. A failed evidence port call throws → DEGRADED (fail-closed: no guessing).

query {kind: ops|entities|rules|lexicon|plugins|contacts, filter?} → {kind, filter, count, rows, worldV} — a focused view derived from the same snapshot machinery (identical semantics, only the slice differs). READ semantics by kind.
bootstrap {} → {bootstrap} — D-328a versioned first contact: composition, model version, entry points, namespaces, the orienting sequence (describe → snapshot). READ-only, zero write path.

describe {focus?: {kind?, capability?, version?}} → Outcome<{control}> — D-328a bounded system projection: versions, namespaces, kinds, capabilities (config catalog), contracts, evaluators, policy boundaries (live forbidden-overlay state when reported), evolution activity. Unknown kind/capability/version → UNKNOWN, never a crash. READ-only.

portrait {} → {portrait} — D-350, one unified self-read: kernel (live law registry: plugins/events/consents/generation), vault (vault.verify@1's recomputed Merkle head + per-namespace row counts through the mind's own lens: email/automation/nlcl/control), world (the SAME WorldModel machinery as mind.snapshot@1), and the capabilities catalog. READ semantics by kind; needs port:vault.verify@1 granted by the composition or the call fails DEGRADED (fail-closed: the portrait never guesses).

capabilities.justification: Deriving the self-model from EVIDENCE requires exactly four READ ports: law.registry@1 (live plugin states for the ops-catalog liveness cross-check, world.kernel.plugins, and the portrait's kernel slice: events/consents/generation), vault.query@1 + vault.getmany@1 (message/rule/lexicon rows in ns email, automation, nlcl — every entity the mind claims traces to a vault revision; D-387 replaced the per-row vault.get@1 loop with ONE batched hop per namespace), and vault.verify@1 (the portrait's data-plane integrity slice: the recomputed Merkle chain head — D-350). The mind requests NO write capability — it is a lens, never an author. These grants are made per-composition by the user-signed Recipe, never by this manifest.
